blocks.note: North America is the largest region and adds about USD 1 Bn by 2033.
blocks.text: North America is the largest regional market, with **41.27%** of global revenue in 2025. It grows from **USD 1,374.14 Mn** to **USD 2,360.70 Mn** by 2033, adding **USD 986.6 Mn**, a CAGR of **7.05%** over 2026–2033 (calculated).

blocks.note: The U.S. holds 80% of the new revenue; Mexico and Canada grow faster.
blocks.text: The **U.S.** adds **USD 795.0 Mn**, 80.6% of the regional increment (calculated). **Mexico** grows fastest at **8.76%** and **Canada** at **7.73%**, against **6.82%** in the U.S.

blocks.note: QuidelOrtho leads both the U.S. and Canada.
blocks.text: **QuidelOrtho** leads both the U.S. (25.5%) and Canada (23.0%). The second supplier differs: **Werfen (Immucor)** in the U.S. (13.5%) and **Roche** in Canada (21.5%).

items.q: Where is the incremental revenue in North America?
items.a: The U.S. adds USD 795.0 Mn, Canada USD 108.9 Mn and Mexico USD 82.7 Mn between 2025 and 2033.

items.q: How should we sequence the countries?
items.a: Lead with the U.S. on scale and automation; enter Canada through operator qualification and Mexico through distributors and tenders.

items.q: Are segment splits available for North America?
items.a: No. The report publishes North America by country but not by segment; global segment growth is shown in Chapter 05 for reference only.

blocks.text: QuidelOrtho leads both countries. Abbott is third in the U.S. (12.7%) but outside the Canadian top five; Roche is second in Canada (21.5%) but outside the U.S. top five. In Mexico, QuidelOrtho, Immucor, Grifols, Bio-Rad, Abbott, Roche and Siemens Healthineers compete; shares are not published.

Recent company activity in the region is almost entirely U.S. regulatory: FDA clearances and approvals from Roche (donor screening on cobas pro), QuidelOrtho (MTS DAT Card, RESOLVE panels, ORTHO Optix Reader), Immucor (ImmuLINK middleware, C3d plate, Anti-D labeling) and Grifols (Erytra Eflexis), plus Grifols' San Diego DG Gel manufacturing.
